svg.title: Two ways to adapt a robot policy to a new task
svg.desc: Two ways to adapt a robot policy to a new task. Conventional adaptation: new task variant, collect action-labelled demonstrations, fine-tune the policy, validate, deploy, then repeat the whole loop for every new variant. WIZARD: new task variant, an instruction plus one visual demonstration without action labels, generate an adapter in one forward pass, validate, deploy. Expert and meta-network training happens once, offline, and is shared across future tasks.
svg.text: Two ways to adapt a robot policy to a new task
Every variant runs the whole loop
The loop is replaced by one forward pass
